description:
A payment processing system is currently tightly coupled to a concrete implementation. Your goal is to decouple it using the 'Extract Interface' refactoring.

1. Open the 'payment-platform' project.
2. In 'StripeService.java', extract a new interface named 'PaymentGateway' containing the business methods: 'charge', 'refund', and 'verifyCard'. Keep helper methods like 'connectToStripeAPI' private/internal to the class.
3. Ensure 'StripeService' implements this new interface.
4. Refactor 'CheckoutService.java' to depend on the 'PaymentGateway' interface instead of the concrete 'StripeService' class.
5. Verify the project still compiles successfully.
